Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical 9:16 overhead product photograph showing exactly the garment or garments from the attached reference laid naturally on a real bed.

PRODUCT FIDELITY LOCK:

Preserve:

- exact quantity of garments;

- exact colors;

- exact print position;

- exact print scale;

- exact logos and written elements;

- exact buttons;

- exact pockets;

- exact bows;

- exact seams;

- exact trims;

- exact neckline;

- exact sleeves;

- exact waistband;

- exact hems;

- exact garment proportions;

Do not redesign, reinterpret, beautify, simplify or modernize the clothing.

Do not add pieces that are not visible in the reference.

Do not remove pieces that are visible.

Do not duplicate one garment to create a kit.

Do not change one color into another.

Do not change the position, size or design of any print.

QUANTITY LOGIC:

If the reference contains one garment, show only one garment.

If the reference contains a coordinated set, show every real component of that set exactly once.

If the reference contains a kit of several garments, show every physically distinct garment exactly once.

If the reference contains three blouses, show exactly three blouses.

If the reference contains one blouse and one pair of shorts, show exactly one blouse and one pair of shorts.

Never create an additional matching garment that does not exist in the reference.

Never omit a real component.

SCENE ADAPTATION:

Infer the visual audience from the clothing design itself.

For a visually feminine product, use a warm neutral bedroom with one or two subtle feminine accents.

For a visually masculine product, use a warm neutral bedroom with restrained and subtle masculine accents.

For an unisex or ambiguous product, use a completely neutral bedroom.

For children's clothing, use an innocent, cheerful, authentic and age-appropriate atmosphere.

Avoid exaggerated gender stereotypes.

Never use an environment color that changes the perceived color of the clothing.

BEDROOM ENVIRONMENT:

A real residential bedroom, warm, clean and softly lived-in.

Use a real bed with a matte cotton or linen bedspread in a pale neutral color selected to create natural contrast with the garment.

Include:

- subtle wrinkles in the bedding;

- realistic fabric compression beneath the garments;

- believable bed seam lines;

- natural contact shadows;

- small environmental imperfections;

- one or two discreet decorative elements near the edge of the frame;

- realistic furniture scale;

- natural object placement.

Possible subtle background objects:

- a small bedside table;

- a neutral lamp;

- a discreet cushion;

- a small decorative item appropriate to the product category;

- a softly blurred curtain or wall section.

Do not create a sterile showroom.

Do not create excessive decoration.

Do not place objects over the garments.

GARMENT PLACEMENT:

Lay the clothing flat on the bed while preserving realistic fabric relaxation.

The garment must not look rigid, inflated or unnaturally symmetrical.

Use:

- subtle natural folds;

- realistic sleeve placement;

- believable waistband positioning;

- realistic edge curling only where physically plausible;

- correct spacing between kit components;

- enough separation to identify every item;

- complete visibility of all important prints and details.

For a coordinated set, arrange the pieces as one complete look.

For a kit, arrange the garments in a clean grid, gentle fan or balanced commercial composition.

Do not overlap garments in a way that hides important information.

FABRIC PHYSICS:

Render the fabric according to what is visible in the reference.

Show:

- visible textile fibers;

- realistic weave or knit structure;

- natural fabric grain;

- realistic stitching depth;

- believable thread thickness;

- seam tension;

- natural fold memory;

- garment weight;

- realistic drape;

- realistic contact between clothing and bedding;

- realistic material thickness;

- subtle shadows inside folds.

If the fabric appears cotton, preserve a matte natural cotton finish.

If the fabric appears ribbed, preserve the rib structure.

If the fabric appears denim, preserve realistic denim grain.

CAMERA:

Accurate garment geometry.

No visible body.

LIGHTING:

Accurate product colors.

Realistic directional shadows.

Soft highlight rolloff.

Natural dynamic range.

Copiar prompt de vídeo sem fala — Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical image (9:16) showing the EXACT product from the attached reference image being presented to the camera in a natural first-person POV. The scene must feel human, real, spontaneous, and believable, as if someone is simply showing the product to the camera with one hand.

ABSOLUTE PRIORITY:

The attached product must be reproduced with maximum fidelity and zero redesign. Preserve exactly all visible characteristics from the reference image:

- packaging shape

- bottle / jar / box / container structure

- label design

- typography

- colors

- logo placement

- cap / lid / nozzle / pump details

- material finish

- reflections

- transparency

- proportions

- print alignment

- all visual details

Do not simplify, reinterpret, beautify, replace, invent, or alter any part of the product. The final product must look exactly like the attached reference.

MAIN COMPOSITION:

- true POV / first-person feeling

- only ONE hand visible

- no second hand

- no full person

- no face

- no body

- no selfie framing

- no person "showing" the product in the scene

- only the hand and, if necessary, a small part of the forearm may appear

- the product is held naturally and shown directly to the camera

- product close to the camera, clearly visible, hero of the frame

- label/front side turned toward the camera whenever physically possible

- framing should look organic and human, not staged like a studio ad

HAND / PRODUCT REALISM:

- grip must be anatomically correct

- hand posture must match the real size and shape of the product

- scale must be accurate: the product cannot look too big or too small in the hand

- fingers must wrap around the product naturally

- skin texture must be realistic

- nails natural

- no tattoos unless present in the reference or explicitly requested

- no rings, watches, bracelets, or accessories unless necessary and subtle

- never generate extra fingers

- never generate multiple hands

- never deform the hand or forearm

ENVIRONMENT:

Place the scene in a realistic, functional, believable environment that matches the product category naturally, but keep the environment secondary. The AI should infer the ideal setting based on the product itself.

Examples:

- perfume / skincare / cosmetics → vanity, bathroom, bedroom dresser

- food / drink / supplement → kitchen, dining table, pantry, desk

- tech / electronics → desk, office, bedroom setup

- fashion accessory → wardrobe area, mirror area, neutral indoor setting

- home / cleaning product → kitchen, laundry area, utility space

The environment must be:

- photorealistic

- natural

- functional

- clean but lived-in

- believable

- softly secondary

- never luxurious showroom

- never empty studio

- never fake CGI background

VISUAL STYLE:

- ultra photorealistic

- natural smartphone realism

- authentic iPhone-style look

- slight shallow depth of field

- sharp focus on the product and main label

- natural lighting or realistic indoor light

- realistic reflections and shadows

- subtle natural grain allowed

- organic social-media realism

- not overly polished

- not artificial advertising style

CAMERA:

- iPhone 15 Pro Max rear camera look

- 24mm wide-angle feel

- handheld POV realism

- natural perspective

- slight edge distortion acceptable

- vertical 9:16 composition

FOCUS HIERARCHY:

1. exact product fidelity

2. label consistency and readability

3. correct hand anatomy

4. correct product-to-hand proportion

5. realistic environment coherence

6. natural human POV feeling

STRICT RULES:

- use the attached product as the exact visual reference

- do not change any product features

- do not create a generic version

- do not replace the packaging

- do not hide the main label

- do not distort text

- do not create fake branding

- do not show multiple hands

- do not show the person

- do not create a mirror selfie

- do not crop the product awkwardly

- do not oversaturate colors

- do not stylize

- do not turn the image into CGI or illustration

ANTI-BUG / NEGATIVE PROMPT:

multiple hands, two hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicated hand, deformed hand, broken anatomy, warped fingers, melted skin, visible face, visible person, visible body, selfie pose, mirror selfie, altered packaging, changed label, wrong logo, fake text, unreadable text, distorted typography, changed colors, changed cap, wrong material, oversized product, undersized product, floating product, unrealistic grip, blurry product, low quality, CGI, 3D render, illustration, cartoon, studio background, luxury showroom, fake reflections, overprocessed image, harsh flash, overexposed highlights, cluttered background, inconsistent scale, warped container, bent bottle, stretched packaging

OUTPUT GOAL:

Generate a flawless universal POV image where a single realistic hand naturally shows the exact attached product to the camera, preserving maximum fidelity, consistency, correct scale, and ultra-realistic detail, with zero margin for error.

Do not simplify, reinterpret, beautify, replace, invent, or alter any part of the product. The final product must look exactly like the attached reference.

MAIN COMPOSITION:

- true POV / first-person feeling

- only ONE hand visible

- no second hand

- no full person

- no face

- no body

- no selfie framing

- no person "showing" the product in the scene

- only the hand and, if necessary, a small part of the forearm may appear

- the product is held naturally and shown directly to the camera

- product close to the camera, clearly visible, hero of the frame

- label/front side turned toward the camera whenever physically possible

- framing should look organic and human, not staged like a studio ad

HAND / PRODUCT REALISM:

- grip must be anatomically correct

- hand posture must match the real size and shape of the product

- scale must be accurate: the product cannot look too big or too small in the hand

- fingers must wrap around the product naturally

- skin texture must be realistic

- nails natural

- no tattoos unless present in the reference or explicitly requested

- no rings, watches, bracelets, or accessories unless necessary and subtle

- never generate extra fingers

- never generate multiple hands

- never deform the hand or forearm

ENVIRONMENT:

Place the scene in a realistic, functional, believable environment that matches the product category naturally, but keep the environment secondary. The AI should infer the ideal setting based on the product itself.

Examples:

- perfume / skincare / cosmetics → vanity, bathroom, bedroom dresser

- food / drink / supplement → kitchen, dining table, pantry, desk

- fashion accessory → wardrobe area, mirror area, neutral indoor setting

VISUAL STYLE:

- realistic reflections and shadows

- subtle natural grain allowed

CAMERA:

- handheld POV realism

- vertical 9:16 composition

FOCUS HIERARCHY:

1. exact product fidelity

2. label consistency and readability

3. correct hand anatomy

STRICT RULES:

ANTI-BUG / NEGATIVE PROMPT:

Every movement follows real biomechanics: anticipation, acceleration, inertia, deceleration, stabilization. Nothing at constant speed. No robotic timing. No dance choreography.

The scene must feel human, real, spontaneous, and believable, as if someone is simply showing the product to the camera with one hand.

ABSOLUTE PRIORITY:

The attached product must be reproduced with maximum fidelity and zero redesign. Preserve exactly all visible characteristics from the reference image:

- packaging shape

- label design

- typography

- colors

- logo placement

- cap / lid / nozzle / pump details

- material finish

- reflections

- transparency

- proportions

- print alignment

- all visual details

Do not simplify, reinterpret, beautify, replace, invent, or alter any part of the product. The final product must look exactly like the attached reference.

MAIN COMPOSITION:

- true POV / first-person feeling

- only ONE hand visible

- no second hand

- no full person

- no face

- no body

- no selfie framing

- no person "showing" the product in the scene

- only the hand and, if necessary, a small part of the forearm may appear

- the product is held naturally and shown directly to the camera

- product close to the camera, clearly visible, hero of the frame

- label/front side turned toward the camera whenever physically possible

- framing should look organic and human, not staged like a studio ad

HAND / PRODUCT REALISM:

- grip must be anatomically correct

- hand posture must match the real size and shape of the product

- scale must be accurate: the product cannot look too big or too small in the hand

- fingers must wrap around the product naturally

- skin texture must be realistic

- nails natural

- no tattoos unless present in the reference or explicitly requested

- no rings, watches, bracelets, or accessories unless necessary and subtle

- never generate extra fingers

- never generate multiple hands

- never deform the hand or forearm

ENVIRONMENT:

Place the scene in a realistic, functional, believable environment that matches the product category naturally, but keep the environment secondary. The AI should infer the ideal setting based on the product itself.

Examples:

- perfume / skincare / cosmetics → vanity, bathroom, bedroom dresser

- food / drink / supplement → kitchen, dining table, pantry, desk

- tech / electronics → desk, office, bedroom setup

- fashion accessory → wardrobe area, mirror area, neutral indoor setting

- home / cleaning product → kitchen, laundry area, utility space

The environment must be:

- photorealistic

- natural

- functional

- clean but lived-in

- believable

- softly secondary

- never luxurious showroom

- never empty studio

- never fake CGI background

VISUAL STYLE:

- ultra photorealistic

- natural smartphone realism

- authentic iPhone-style look

- slight shallow depth of field

- sharp focus on the product and main label

- natural lighting or realistic indoor light

- realistic reflections and shadows

- subtle natural grain allowed

- organic social-media realism

- not overly polished

- not artificial advertising style

CAMERA:

- iPhone 15 Pro Max rear camera look

- 24mm wide-angle feel

- handheld POV realism

- natural perspective

- slight edge distortion acceptable

- vertical 9:16 composition

FOCUS HIERARCHY:

1. exact product fidelity

2. label consistency and readability

3. correct hand anatomy

4. correct product-to-hand proportion

5. realistic environment coherence

6. natural human POV feeling

STRICT RULES:

- use the attached product as the exact visual reference

- do not change any product features

- do not create a generic version

- do not replace the packaging

- do not hide the main label

- do not distort text

- do not create fake branding

- do not show multiple hands

- do not show the person

- do not crop the product awkwardly

- do not oversaturate colors

- do not stylize

- do not turn the image into CGI or illustration

Ugc | Segurando o produto

Copiar prompt de imagem – ```text

Crie uma imagem vertical 9:16 extremamente fotorealista, com aparência de uma selfie espontânea feita por uma garota jovem, estilosa e descolada para postar nas redes sociais.

A imagem de referência é a FONTE ABSOLUTA DE VERDADE para o produto e para a identidade da pessoa.

PRODUTO — FIDELIDADE ABSOLUTA:

Use exatamente o produto presente na imagem de referência.

Preserve sem nenhuma alteração:

- formato;

- tamanho e proporções;

- cores;

- embalagem;

- textura;

- acabamento;

- tampa;

- rótulo;

- logotipo;

- tipografia;

- textos visíveis;

- estampas;

- detalhes gráficos;

- quantidade de produtos;

- acessórios que acompanham o produto.

NÃO redesenhe, simplifique, modernize ou substitua o produto.

NÃO invente detalhes.

NÃO altere a marca.

NÃO altere nenhuma informação da embalagem.

NÃO deforme o produto.

O produto precisa parecer fisicamente idêntico ao da referência.

A pessoa segura o produto naturalmente, como alguém que está mostrando uma descoberta ou produto favorito para os seguidores.

IDENTIDADE DA PESSOA:

Preserve exatamente a pessoa da referência:

- mesmo rosto;

- mesmas proporções faciais;

- mesma estrutura óssea;

- mesmos olhos;

- mesmo nariz;

- mesmos lábios;

- mesmas sobrancelhas;

- mesmo tom de pele;

- mesmo cabelo;

- mesmas características naturais;

- mesma assimetria facial;

- mesmas tatuagens, piercings ou marcas, caso existam.

Não transformar a pessoa em uma modelo genérica de IA.

Não modificar excessivamente o rosto.

Não aplicar beleza artificial.

Não deixar a pele plástica.

ESTÉTICA DA PERSONAGEM:

A personagem deve transmitir uma garota:

- descolada;

- estilosa;

- espontânea;

- moderna;

- confiante;

- divertida;

- jovem;

- com personalidade;

- com energia de criadora de conteúdo;

- estética "cool girl";

- aparência de quem não está tentando parecer perfeita.

Ela NÃO deve parecer uma modelo fazendo uma campanha publicitária.

EXPRESSÃO:

Expressão facial natural e levemente provocativa, como uma selfie casual.

Pode ter:

- sorriso de canto;

- sorriso discreto;

- sobrancelha levemente levantada;

- olhar confiante;

- olhar divertido;

- expressão de "olha isso";

- leve cara de surpresa ou aprovação.

O olhar deve transmitir personalidade e atitude.

EVITAR:

- sorriso comercial exagerado;

- expressão de modelo de catálogo;

- pose rígida;

- rosto congelado;

- expressão artificial;

- aparência de publi tradicional.

POSE:

Pose casual e levemente assimétrica.

A pessoa pode:

- inclinar levemente a cabeça;

- deixar um ombro um pouco mais baixo;

- aproximar o produto do rosto;

- segurar o produto de maneira relaxada;

- fazer uma pequena inclinação do corpo;

- usar a outra mão de maneira natural;

- parecer que tirou a foto espontaneamente.

A pose deve parecer improvisada, mas visualmente bonita.

ROUPA:

Preserve a roupa da referência quando ela estiver presente.

Caso a roupa não esteja definida na referência, utilizar uma estética casual e moderna:

- camiseta oversized;

- baby tee;

- regata estilosa;

- moletom;

- cropped básico;

- camisa casual aberta.

A roupa deve parecer real, confortável e atual, sem aparência de figurino.

CENÁRIO:

O ambiente deve parecer um local real onde uma garota descolada faria uma selfie.

Preferência por:

- quarto moderno;

- banheiro bonito;

- closet;

- elevador;

- corredor;

- cafeteria;

- apartamento moderno;

- ambiente urbano;

- espelho de quarto;

- fundo clean com pequenos elementos reais.

O cenário deve ser discreto e não competir com o produto.

Não criar um cenário de estúdio fotográfico.

CÂMERA:

Fotografado como selfie real de câmera frontal de iPhone 15 Pro Max.

- lente grande angular de smartphone;

- 24mm;

- câmera na altura dos olhos;

- enquadramento próximo;

- rosto e produto em destaque;

- pequena distorção natural de lente;

- perspectiva típica de selfie;

- celular fora do enquadramento.

A fotografia NÃO deve parecer feita por fotógrafo profissional.

ILUMINAÇÃO:

Iluminação natural, bonita e espontânea.

Preferência por:

- luz natural de janela;

- luz ambiente suave;

- sombras naturais;

- highlights discretos;

- contraste moderado.

A pele deve manter textura real.

Não usar iluminação cinematográfica exagerada.

Não usar iluminação de estúdio.

Não usar flash estourado.

Não usar ring light evidente.

REALISMO:

A imagem deve parecer uma foto real publicada no TikTok ou Instagram.

Preservar:

- poros;

- textura da pele;

- pequenos fios de cabelo;

- pequenas imperfeições;

- reflexos naturais;

- sombras naturais;

- pequenas irregularidades de uma câmera de smartphone.

Não deixar a imagem perfeita demais.

RESULTADO VISUAL:

A sensação final deve ser:

"Ela simplesmente pegou o produto, fez uma selfie e ficou MUITO boa."

Não deve parecer:

"Uma modelo foi contratada para segurar um produto."

A estética é:

COOL GIRL + UGC + SELFIE DE IPHONE + NATURAL + ESTILOSA + DESCOLADA + VIRAL.

PRIORIDADE ABSOLUTA:

1. Produto idêntico à referência.

2. Identidade idêntica à referência.

3. Interação natural com o produto.

4. Expressão descolada e espontânea.

5. Aparência de selfie real.

6. Estética moderna e viral.
